latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of BrainASLab — FreeSurfer Asymmetry Analyzer

- Parses cortical ROI metrics from FreeSurfer `lh.aparc.stats` and `rh.aparc.stats` files
- Computes Asymmetry Index (AS) for Thickness, Area, and Volume
- Generates publication-ready bar and histogram plots
- Outputs AS_results.csv and relevant plot images
- Requires Matlab installed and available in PATH
